subject: An elderly Chettiar woman stringing a jasmine (malligai) flower garland, wearing a handloom Kanchipuram silk sari in mustard and maroon with a temple-border weave

setting.place: The inner courtyard (mutram) of a 19th-century Chettinad mansion in Karaikudi, Sivaganga district, Tamil Nadu, with teak pillars, Athangudi tiled floor and brass lamps
setting.era: Present day, during the Margazhi month, with a fresh kolam drawn on the damp floor

lighting: soft diffused dawn light falling through the courtyard opening, gentle highlights on the silk

motion.subject_motion: her hands slowly threading jasmine buds onto the string, flowers swaying slightly
motion.camera_move: slow push-in from medium shot towards the hands
